svg.title: Constipation decision chart: red flags send the patient to colonoscopy for a structural cause, a secondary cause is found on history and basic labs, and the rest is primary: functional constipation treated in steps, with slow transit and defecatory disorders found by transit study and anorectal testing when first-line treatment fails
